GAP-A (biggest, arithmetic): the anchor uses RI-PRG06 SUPERSEDED §3 decomposition (N=576), not §7's ADOPTED census (~1,230). §7 is binding: souls_each_shipped = souls_each_§3 x 576/N_shipped, factor 0.468 at 1,230. inf_trash should be ~64, not 136. K should be 0.1026, not 0.219191.

GAP-A consequence: if the population agent lands the planned ~1,230 enemies at the shipped values, world total = 1,124,285 x 2.14 = ~2.41M souls >= 2,391,999 = L120 exactly. RI-PRG06 method 10's L120 guard scoring row '0 (we lose)' is '100% clear reaches L115+'. R1 alone would pay ~27,000 souls -> ~L20, vs method 1's required level 13-15.

GAP-B: derive-soul-values --check's band assertion is NEARLY VACUOUS. RI-PRG06 §2's TRASH bands union to a CONTIGUOUS 35-6,200 (35-190,140-520,330-1250,760-2600,1200-4200,2100-6200). bandOf() accepts any value in that range regardless of the enemy's REGION, so the check only rejects <35 and >6,200. champion_hist_marked at 2,423 is reported as 'R4 trash' and passes; it is an R1-region elite. Method 6 (band separation) is not enforced by anything.

GAP-C: the header's FIVE death paths are wrong. `sim/player.js:233` is DEAD CODE - nothing imports stepPlayer (events.js:19 says so in-tree, and AGENT-PROTOCOL names this exact trap). `sim/hazards.js` runs inside Engine._settleWorld(), which step.js calls AFTER stepSouls; and combat-bridge mirror() (end of stepCombat, BEFORE stepSouls) overwrites e.hp from the combat body every frame, so a hazard's write to ent.hp on a body-backed entity is both invisible to the scan and undone. Two more real death paths are unlisted: sim/magic/system.js:1040 and sim/magic/apply.js:164.

sim.entities is a VIEW: combat-bridge mirror() sets e.hp = max(0, eb.hp) for every entity WITH a combat body. Anything that kills by writing sim.entities directly (hazards, sim/player.js resolveHits) is clobbered next frame.
All 19 hazards declare applies_to_npcs:true; voriplasm is class KILL / fatal. So the hazard death path is real in intent and (per GAP-C) unpayable in fact.

MEASURED (browser, my probe tools/progression/critic-souls-r1.mjs): a REAL WEAPON KILL pays. 42 latched light swings, inf_trash dies on frame 1421, souls 0->136, exactly 1 souls_awarded event. NOTE: all 12 arms of the builder's suite kill with H.killEntity(); nothing in it ever lands a hit. K1 is the first evidence that a fight pays.

MEASURED TTK = 1,421 f@60 = 23.68 s of continuous fighting, reproduced identically across two runs. Browser AGREES with the builder's node figure (21.7-23.4 s) for this short fight. RI-PRG06's budget is 1.49 min (89 s) per killed enemy, so fighting is 26% of R1 wall clock at N=93. At the ADOPTED census (~199 R1 enemies) the budget falls to 41.8 s/kill and fighting becomes 57% of region 1 at the typical 78% kill rate - RI-PRG06's own provenance risk 3 ('combat TTK differs'), now measured.

MEASURED: the HAZARD death path pays NOTHING and RESURRECTS the corpse. Wrote ent.hp 412->0 exactly as sim/hazards.js H9 does; one frame later hp is 412 again and souls moved 0; after 31 frames still 412/+0. combat-bridge mirror() runs at the end of stepCombat, BEFORE stepSouls, and restores e.hp from the untouched combat body. One of the builder's five named death paths does not work.

MEASURED: re-kill farm. spawnEncounter mints DETERMINISTIC eids (dres-raid-party-infantry-0...). kill -> despawn -> respawn -> kill pays 816 souls EVERY pass; 3 passes = 2,448 souls with ZERO hearth rests. _alive is keyed on eid and never pruned, so the re-arm branch treats a re-spawn as a S5 respawn. Today only reachable via _resolveCapture() and the harness; W1-POPULATION has declared Engine._streamProvince() (a distance-driven despawn/respawn pump) as its placement slot, which makes this a walk-away-and-back farm the day the population lands.

MEASURED: souls-consumption arm D is VACUOUS on its error path. Predicate is `D.declared_souls === 0 && (!D.kill || D.kill.delta === 0)`. Forced the dummy spawn to throw (duplicate eid); D still returns PASS. Arms B and I are vacuous on the skipped-kill path: a skipped kill has delta 0 and B counts it (`B.kills.length > 0` includes skips), and I asserts only souls_at_save === souls_after_load with no requirement that a kill ever paid. In the builder's own -DELETED run arm I passed with the_kill.delta = 0.
K4: the player is NOT in sim.entities, so the scan cannot pay for the player's own death. No defect.
